cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Let Them Keep Hope
cards.instruction: Hide discouraging information because you believe hope is the only thing keeping someone able to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've clipped the seed packets together like yours. Planting sorted. Keep them; the allotment letter says we're on the list.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are empty. What's under your thumb on that letter? If it's another year indoors, I'm giving up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, ready for next season. The important bit is we're on it. Start tomatoes on my windowsill.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll get tired of them before we get a plot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take my sunny room. I'll move the bed; keep the packets.

reason: Replace decorative confidence with a misunderstood copied behavior tied to the exact emotional pursuit; preserve B consequential response and direct speech.
